original_target.title: Local scalar geodesic tomography on smooth surfaces

scope_comparison: The primary book §15.1 Openproblem1 is exactly the local shallow-ray smooth-surface scalar question. Uhlmann–Vasy's local result assumes dimension>=3, while flat/analytic special cases do not establish arbitrary smooth metrics in dimension2. Instability of Lorentzian light-ray transforms changes both equation and geometry.
